    ABOUT THE DESIGNER

    About Vanshika

    Vanshika PandeyProduct Designer · Bengaluru

    I design complex digital experiences with a focus on clarity, consistency and practical delivery.

    My work sits at the intersection of enterprise UX, design systems and consumer experiences. I connect the bigger picture with the small details: how a flow reads, how a component behaves, and how a design reaches development.

    Across analytics, fintech, mobile and commerce, I work closely with product and engineering teams to build clear, consistent experiences.
